description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Seagate Technology develops embedded software for its storage products. The Embedded Software Engineer I analyzes, designs, implements, debugs, and maintains embedded software components, and helps improve product reliability, performance, and software quality.
Embedded Software Engineer I developing and maintaining C/C++ components, improving architecture, and troubleshooting system-level issues

Responsibilities:
• Analyze, design, implement, debug, and maintain embedded software components in C/C++
• Apply computer science fundamentals to solve product software problems
• Build modular, testable software with clear interfaces, appropriate abstraction, and maintainable structure
• Improve embedded software architecture for reuse, performance, reliability, and long-term ownership
• Troubleshoot software and system-level issues across embedded software, hardware, and storage product behavior
• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and defect prevention practices to improve software quality

Requirements:
• You want to build reliable embedded systems with software that is understandable, testable, extensible, and sustainable
• You are curious about how software interacts with hardware, operating systems, storage architecture, and product behavior
• You break down complex problems, reason from first principles, and communicate technical tradeoffs clearly
• Strong foundation in core computer science concepts, including operating systems, concurrency, memory management, and computer architecture
• Programming experience in C/C++, Rust, Python or similar languages
• Understanding embedded systems, resource-constrained design, hardware/software interaction, and modern development practices
• Bachelor's degree in engineering related field (i.e. Computer Science or related technicial field) and 0+ years of experience

Preferred:
• Experience with embedded operating systems, device drivers, storage systems, real-time software, or low-level platform software
• Exposure to modular architecture, interface contracts, testable design, build systems, CI/CD, or software quality tools
• Knowledge of HDD devices, storage protocols, system-level performance analysis, or storage subsystem topologies
